fatal_error.cause: The fixed-multiplier CDFT OUTER_SCF omitted OPTIMIZER. CP2K used NONE, which the CDFT initial-information output routine does not handle.
fatal_error.correction: Name OPTIMIZER BISECT explicitly while retaining MAX_SCF 0; CP2K then exits after the first fixed-multiplier evaluation and before an optimizer update.

atomic_guess_defect.cause: CP2K applies one half of each KIND/BS NEL value to a spin occupation; the rejected registry treated NEL as a literal electron count.
atomic_guess_defect.correction: For q=1 use ALPHA 2p NEL 0 and BETA 2p NEL -2, giving integer alpha/beta carbon populations 3/2 and five electrons.

scientific_scope: CP2K aborted before the molecular inner SCF. No CDFT population, energy, force, trace, wavefunction, or branch checkpoint from this probe is accepted.
